    //==
    // # PoissonDistribution
    //
    // Parameterization: Rate (lambda) is the EXPECTED COUNT over the fixed
    // window, not a per-unit-time rate to be multiplied by a duration. Support
    // is the whole numbers; Pdf reads the mass at the value rounded down.
    // Precondition: Rate > 0.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poisson_distribution

    // The mean: the rate.
    Mean(self: PoissonDistribution): Number
        => self.Rate;

    // The variance: the rate (a Poisson variable is equidispersed).
    Variance(self: PoissonDistribution): Number
        => self.Rate;

    // The mass at k = floor(value): lambda^k * exp(-lambda) / k!, zero for
    // negative values. Exact in form; the explicit factorial limits usable k to
    // roughly 170 before overflow.
    Pdf(self: PoissonDistribution, value: Number): Number
    {
        var k = value.Floor.ToInteger;
        return k < 0
            ? 0.0
            : self.Rate.Pow(k.ToNumber) * (-self.Rate).Exp / Factorial(k);
    }

    // The cumulative mass at k = floor(value), by direct summation of the masses
    // 0..k. Exact in form and O(k); the closed form is a regularized incomplete
    // gamma, which this tree cannot express.
    Cdf(self: PoissonDistribution, value: Number): Number
    {
        var k = value.Floor.ToInteger;
        return k < 0
            ? 0.0
            : (k + 1).Range
                .Map(i => self.Pdf(i.ToNumber))
                .Reduce(0.0, (total, mass) => total + mass);
    }

    //==
    // # DiscreteDistribution
    //
    // Parameterization: outcome i in 0..Count-1 carries probability
    // Weights[i] / sum(Weights); the weights are non-negative and need not be
    // normalized. Pdf reads the mass at the value rounded down. Precondition:
    // Weights is non-empty and its sum is positive.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Categorical_distribution

    // The total weight; the normalizing constant for every other body here.
    TotalWeight(self: DiscreteDistribution): Number
        => self.Weights.Reduce(0.0, (total, weight) => total + weight);

    // The mean outcome index: the weight-weighted average of 0..Count-1.
    Mean(self: DiscreteDistribution): Number
        => self.Weights.Count.Range
            .Map(i => i.ToNumber * self.Weights[i])
            .Reduce(0.0, (total, term) => total + term)
         / self.TotalWeight;

    // The variance of the outcome index, as E[i^2] - E[i]^2.
    Variance(self: DiscreteDistribution): Number
        => self.Weights.Count.Range
            .Map(i => i.ToNumber.Square * self.Weights[i])
            .Reduce(0.0, (total, term) => total + term)
         / self.TotalWeight
         - self.Mean.Square;

    // The mass at outcome k = floor(value): Weights[k] over the total weight,
    // zero outside 0..Count-1. Exact.
    Pdf(self: DiscreteDistribution, value: Number): Number
    {
        var k = value.Floor.ToInteger;
        return k < 0 || k >= self.Weights.Count
            ? 0.0
            : self.Weights[k] / self.TotalWeight;
    }

    // The cumulative mass at outcome k = floor(value): the weights of outcomes
    // 0..k over the total weight, clamped to the ends of the support. Exact.
    Cdf(self: DiscreteDistribution, value: Number): Number
    {
        var k = value.Floor.ToInteger;
        return k < 0
            ? 0.0
            : k >= self.Weights.Count - 1
                ? 1.0
                : (k + 1).Range
                    .Map(i => self.Weights[i])
                    .Reduce(0.0, (total, weight) => total + weight)
                    / self.TotalWeight;
    }

    //==
    // # Derived functions for IProbabilityDistribution
    //
    // Bodies for the `IProbabilityDistribution` interface declared in
    // `random.concepts.plato`,
    // which exposes Mean, Variance, Pdf and Cdf. The derived surface is the tail
    // and interval probabilities that read from Cdf, plus the spread and density
    // comparisons. The concrete per-distribution obligation fills (and the named
    // numerical approximations they need) stay in the `random*.library.plato`
    // family; only the interface-generic helpers live here. Pure
    // expressions only; all inputs are immutable and evaluation is side-effect
    // free.

    //==
    // # IProbabilityDistribution
    //
    // A univariate distribution exposing Mean, Variance, Pdf, and Cdf. The
    // derived surface is the tail and interval probabilities that read from Cdf,
    // plus density comparisons
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Probability_distribution).

    // The standard deviation: the square root of the variance, in the same units
    // as the values. Precondition: the variance is non-negative
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard_deviation).
    StandardDeviation(self: IProbabilityDistribution): Number
        => self.Variance.Sqrt;

    // The cumulative probability of drawing at most value; a readable spelling
    // of Cdf (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulative_distribution_function).
    ProbabilityAtMost(self: IProbabilityDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => self.Cdf(value);

    // The survival function at value: the probability of drawing more than
    // value, 1 - Cdf(value)
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Survival_function).
    SurvivalAt(self: IProbabilityDistribution, value: Number): Number
        => 1.0 - self.Cdf(value);

    // The probability mass in the half-open interval (low, high]: Cdf(high) -
    // Cdf(low). Precondition: low <= high.
    ProbabilityBetween(self: IProbabilityDistribution, low: Number, high: Number): Number
        => self.Cdf(high) - self.Cdf(low);

    // The precision: the reciprocal of the variance. Precondition: the variance
    // is positive (undefined for the degenerate and heavy-tailed cases)
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Precision_%28statistics%29).
    Precision(self: IProbabilityDistribution): Number
        => 1.0 / self.Variance;

    // True when value a is at least as likely (dense) as value b under this
    // distribution.
    IsAtLeastAsLikelyAs(self: IProbabilityDistribution, a: Number, b: Number): Boolean
        => self.Pdf(a) >= self.Pdf(b);
}
